page.layout: One text column on the left, with marginal notes in the right margin. Running head "NOTÆ." at top, page number 207 at top right. Catchword "oscitantia" at the foot right, signature "Ee" at the foot left.

main_text.p: sensu, & de [?] modo jas illud transferen-di apud eos qui ad testimonium confugiunt, & [?] modo illud confirmandi, apud eos qui a consensu pendent. De his rebus controverti inter AlShiios, Almotazalos, AlCeramios, & Al Assharios. Haec sunt juxta AlSharestanum, fundamenta magna, seu Cardines earum, quae inter Scholasticos agitantur, controversiarum, seu ut loqui amant Authores libri Echwanossafa, [?] Matres quaestionum controversarum, vel [?], Matres dissensionis.

Decretum ejus & Judicium ] seu propositum Dei & decretum ejus. Voces fere geminae sunt [?] & [?], nec significatu inter se multum diversae, adeo ut utraque decretum sonet. Sic utramque sub Hebraica voce [?] comprehendit Josephus Albo, in Ikkar, l. 1. c. 13. quae inter eas differentia est, ratione antecedentiae & consequentiae statui videtur, ita tamen ut quam priorem statuas ex ipsorum Arabum explicationibus vix colligas, ita enim Ebno'lAthir, lib. lin. 4. [?]

p.i: AlKada, & AlKadar res duae sunt sibi invicem necessario annexae, adeo ut altera ab altera divelli nequeat, cum unam rationem habeat fundamenti, sc. AlKadar, altera scil. AlKadaa aedificii, & qui haec sejungere velit, idem aedificium dirue-re & dissipare conatur. Juxta hanc sententiam antecedere AlKadar, sequi AlKadaa videtur, nisi scribae

page.notes: The Arabic lines are copied as well as the scan allows; the Arabic words marked [?] and the Arabic lines after "Ebno'lAthir" are uncertain. The Hebrew marginal note reads roughly as given and is uncertain in several letters. The Arabic and Hebrew were not checked against a source. "AlShiios", "Echwanossafa", "Al Assharios" and "AlSharestanum" are uncertain spellings. The final line at the foot, "Ee oscitantia", combines the signature and catchword, which are printed on the same baseline; the text part of that line is only the catchword. The reading "sensu" (printed "senfu") follows the long-s rule. The text "scil." is printed "fcil." and is normalised to "scil.". No printing error was corrected.
